claim_views: All twelve benchmark scenarios: witness precision/recall across five types and requests-to-context signed/absolute fraction error and target disagreement. All fixed receipt scenarios: witness versus temporal within each policy, plus original policy contrasts. No selection by outcomes.
correction_rule: Only context-bearing chains making a source appear at a recipient write where captured selection state lacks it. lo=max(source,previous recipient write), or source if no previous; existing request/delivery/context times become lo+gap/4,lo+gap/2,lo+3*gap/4. Strict representable open interval required. No missing stages created; all other values fixed.
failure_handling: Retain failed configurations and every original evaluation/group denominator with explicit unavailable status. Do not attribute legacy reproduction failures to retiming. No alternative corrections or conditions.
paired_analysis: Corrected minus legacy within each world; then mean over original group. Preserve evidence-aware-minus-conjunction per version and difference of those contrasts. No new intervals.
